name: UpperTheory.V.Tower.layerGen
source: ∀ (L Ω : Type) [Field L] [NumberField L] [Field Ω] [Algebra L Ω] [IsAlgClosure L Ω] (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime], HasMuQ l L → (∀ m, (layU l L Ω m).index = l ^ m) ∧
∀ γ : G L Ω, IsGen l ⊤ γ → PropA.IsLevel l (cycZ L Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]ˣ) (cZero l L) ∧ γ ∈ levU l ⊤ 1 ∧ ∀ m, IsGen l (layU l L Ω m) (γ ^ l ^ m) := by
obtain ⟨-, h2, h3, -⟩ := muQ L Ω l
have hr := cycRange L Ω l hmu
obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3⟩ := princGen l _ hq
have h0 : ∀ g, cycZ L Ω l g ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L) := fun g => hr ▸ ⟨g, rfl⟩
have hU : ∀ n, Un L Ω l n = (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l n).comap (cycZ L Ω l) := fun n =>
Subgroup.ext fun g => ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨trivial, h⟩⟩
have h1 : 1 ≤ cZero l L := by
· have hn : cycZ L Ω l γ ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L + 1) := by
· have : γ ∈ Un L Ω l 1 := by rw [(h2 1).2 h1]; trivial
(((princGen l (cZero l L + m) (hq.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))).1 _ (q2 m).1).2 (q2 m).2)
show: Let ℓ be prime and let the number field L satisfy the ℓ-power roots-of-unity hypothesis. The subgroup defining layer m has index ℓᵐ in the absolute Galois group. If the character value of γ topologically generates the base cyclotomic image, it has exact level c₀ and γ belongs to the first congruence subgroup. For every m, γ^(ℓᵐ) belongs to the subgroup defining layer m and its character value topologically generates the cyclotomic image of that subgroup.
strategy: Express the layer subgroups as inverse images of the principal-unit filtration under the cyclotomic character. This gives their indices. The principal-unit generator criterion shows that the character value of γ^(ℓᵐ) generates a dense subgroup of the layer's cyclotomic image.

steps.claim: Write G = Gal(Ω/L), κ for its cyclotomic character, c = c₀(L) and Pₐ for the units congruent to 1 modulo ℓᵃ. The roots in L give q ≤ c and κ(G) = P_c, where q = 2 at ℓ = 2 and q = 1 otherwise. At this depth the generator criterion, the power-depth law and [P_c:P_(c+m)] = ℓᵐ all apply.
steps.snippet:
∀ γ : G L Ω, IsGen l ⊤ γ → PropA.IsLevel l (cycZ L Ω l γ : ℤ_[l]ˣ) (cZero l L) ∧ γ ∈ levU l ⊤ 1 ∧ ∀ m, IsGen l (layU l L Ω m) (γ ^ l ^ m) := by
  intro L Ω _ _ _ _ _ l _ hmu
  obtain ⟨-, h2, h3, -⟩ := muQ L Ω l
  have hq := h3.1 hmu
  have hr := cycRange L Ω l hmu
  obtain ⟨p1, p2, p3⟩ := princGen l _ hq

steps.claim: Every g ∈ G has κ(g) ∈ P_c, because κ(g) is an element of the image κ(G) = P_c.
steps.snippet: have h0 : ∀ g, cycZ L Ω l g ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L) := fun g => hr ▸ ⟨g, rfl⟩
steps.typedFact: ∀ g, cycZ L Ω l g ∈ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L)

steps.claim: For every n, the full-group congruence subgroup Uₙ equals κ⁻¹(Pₙ). Both groups consist exactly of g with κ(g) ≡ 1 modulo ℓⁿ.
steps.snippet:
have hU : ∀ n, Un L Ω l n = (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l n).comap (cycZ L Ω l) := fun n =>
    Subgroup.ext fun g => ⟨fun h => h.2, fun h => ⟨trivial, h⟩⟩
steps.typedFact: ∀ n, Un L Ω l n = (KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l n).comap (cycZ L Ω l)

steps.claim: Since q ≤ c and q is 1 or 2, the base depth c satisfies 1 ≤ c.
steps.snippet: have h1 : 1 ≤ cZero l L := by

children.claim: The initial depth is q = 2 when ℓ = 2 and q = 1 at every odd prime. In both cases 1 ≤ q ≤ c.
The two values of q both satisfy 1 ≤ q, giving the bound in each prime case.
When ℓ = 2, q = 2 and 1 ≤ q follows from 1 ≤ 2.
When ℓ ≠ 2, q = 1 and 1 ≤ q holds with equality.

steps.claim: For every m the subgroup U_(c+m) has index ℓᵐ in G. If κ(G) ⊆ closure⟨κ(γ)⟩, then vℓ(κ(γ)−1) = c, with c ≥ 1 and c ≥ 2 at ℓ = 2, and γ ∈ U₁. For every m, η = γ^(ℓᵐ) belongs to U_(c+m) and κ(U_(c+m)) ⊆ closure⟨κ(η)⟩.

children.claim: For all m, [G:κ⁻¹(P_(c+m))] = [κ(G):P_(c+m)] = [P_c:P_(c+m)] = ℓᵐ, since P_(c+m) ⊆ P_c.

Since κ(γ) generates P_c topologically, it lies outside P_(c+1), has valuation depth c and satisfies κ(γ) ≡ 1 modulo ℓ. Its ℓᵐth power has exact depth c+m, placing γ^(ℓᵐ) in the layer subgroup and giving a topological generator of its cyclotomic image.
children.snippet: · have hn : cycZ L Ω l γ ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L + 1) := by

children.claim: The generating hypothesis gives P_c = κ(G) ⊆ closure⟨κ(γ)⟩. Because κ(γ) ∈ P_c, the principal-unit generator criterion implies κ(γ) lies outside P_(c+1).
children.snippet:
· have hn : cycZ L Ω l γ ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L + 1) := by
      refine (p1 _ (h0 γ)).1 ?_
      rw [← hr, MonoidHom.range_eq_map]
      exact hγ.2
children.typedFact: cycZ L Ω l γ ∉ KStar.TotallyRealRoots.princ l (cZero l L + 1)

children.claim: The exact-depth criterion gives vℓ(κ(γ)−1) = c with c ≥ 1 and c ≥ 2 at ℓ = 2. For every m, κ(γ)^(ℓᵐ) belongs to P_(c+m) and lies outside P_(c+m+1).

The valuation identity gives the required normalized level of κ(γ). The congruence at level 1 puts γ in U₁, and the exact power depth at c+m supplies both membership and cyclotomic generation for each layer.
Because c ≥ 1, the congruence subgroup U₁ is the full Galois group. Hence γ belongs to its level-one congruence subgroup.
children.snippet: · have : γ ∈ Un L Ω l 1 := by rw [(h2 1).2 h1]; trivial

children.claim: Since 1 ≤ c, all of G fixes the roots of order ℓ, so U₁ = G and in particular γ ∈ U₁.
children.snippet: · have : γ ∈ Un L Ω l 1 := by rw [(h2 1).2 h1]; trivial

children.claim: For the full group G, U₁ consists of the elements with κ(g) ≡ 1 modulo ℓ. Thus γ ∈ U₁ is the required first-level congruence.
For η = γ^(ℓᵐ), one has κ(η) = κ(γ)^(ℓᵐ) ∈ P_(c+m) by the power-depth law. Hence η belongs to the mth layer subgroup κ⁻¹(P_(c+m)).
children.snippet:
· rw [layU, hU, Subgroup.mem_comap, map_pow]
      exact (q2 m).1

children.claim: The image κ(κ⁻¹(P_(c+m))) lies in P_(c+m). As q ≤ c+m and κ(γ)^(ℓᵐ) lies in P_(c+m) outside P_(c+m+1), the generator criterion gives P_(c+m) ⊆ closure⟨κ(γ^(ℓᵐ))⟩. This closure therefore contains the layer’s cyclotomic image.
children.snippet:
· rw [layU, hU, map_pow]
      exact (Subgroup.map_comap_le _ _).trans
        (((princGen l (cZero l L + m) (hq.trans (Nat.le_add_right _ _))).1 _ (q2 m).1).2 (q2 m).2)

chapterTitle: Twisted cokernels in a cyclotomic tower
